question: By what percentage was the lactic acid concentration higher in LPGood than in LPBad alfalfa silage?
rendered:
<document title="Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics">

=== page 7 ===
- A significantly (p < 0.05) higher LA concentration was found in the LPGood group.

The lactic acid concentration in the LPGood group was 9.18 ± 0.46 g/kg DM, while in the LPBad group it was 7.51 ± 0.93 g/kg DM.

To calculate the percentage difference, we can use the formula:

((9.18 - 7.51) / 7.51) * 100

This gives us:

(1.67 / 7.51) * 100 = 22.2%

So, the lactic acid concentration was 22.2% higher in LPGood than in LPBad alfalfa silage.

The answer is 22.2%.
